description: Men's grooming rules for hairstyle, beard, sunglasses, hair characteristics, face-shape compatibility, outfit coordination and occasion-based grooming recommendations.

rules.rule: Face shape should be treated as an approximate visual characteristic, not an absolute measurement.
rules.guidance: If the image does not clearly show the forehead, cheekbones, jawline and chin, reduce confidence in face-shape classification.

rules.rule: Use multiple visible facial proportions together when estimating face shape.
rules.guidance: Compare face length, forehead width, cheekbone width, jaw width and chin structure instead of relying on one feature.

rules.rule: Oval face shapes generally have balanced facial proportions with a slightly longer face.
rules.guidance: A wide range of hairstyles and beard shapes can work because the face is visually balanced.

rules.rule: Round face shapes generally have softer jawlines and similar face width and height.
rules.guidance: Hairstyles with controlled side volume and some vertical height can create a more elongated visual effect.

rules.rule: Square face shapes usually show a stronger jawline and relatively balanced facial length and width.
rules.guidance: Both structured and textured hairstyles can work; excessive width at the sides may emphasize facial width.

rules.rule: Oblong face shapes appear noticeably longer than they are wide.
rules.guidance: Avoid adding unnecessary vertical height while maintaining some controlled side volume.

rules.rule: Heart-shaped faces commonly have a wider forehead with a narrower jaw and chin.
rules.guidance: Balanced side volume and moderate fringe can help visually distribute attention across the face.

rules.rule: Diamond-shaped faces often have prominent cheekbones with a narrower forehead and jaw.
rules.guidance: Textured styles with controlled volume can complement the cheekbone structure.

rules.rule: Triangular face shapes can have a stronger or wider jaw relative to the forehead.
rules.guidance: Moderate volume around the upper face can visually balance a stronger lower face.

rules.rule: If the face shape falls between two categories, use a blended recommendation.
rules.guidance: Do not force a single face-shape label when the visual evidence is ambiguous.

rules.rule: Hairstyle recommendations should consider face shape and hair characteristics together.
rules.guidance: Face shape alone should not determine the hairstyle.

rules.rule: Hair texture affects how a hairstyle will naturally sit.
rules.guidance: Straight, wavy, curly and coily hair should receive different styling recommendations when relevant.

rules.rule: Hair density should influence hairstyle selection.
rules.guidance: Low-density hair generally benefits from styles that avoid excessive weight and can create controlled texture.

rules.rule: Thick hair can support structured and textured hairstyles.
rules.guidance: Use controlled layering or tapering when excessive bulk becomes visually heavy.

rules.rule: Straight hair often works well with clean structured hairstyles.
rules.guidance: Side parts, textured crops, layered styles and controlled quiffs can be considered.

rules.rule: Wavy hair can benefit from styles that preserve natural movement.
rules.guidance: Avoid recommendations that require completely eliminating natural texture unless the user specifically wants that look.

rules.rule: Curly hair should generally be styled around its natural curl pattern.
rules.guidance: Recommend shape and length that control volume without unnecessarily removing natural texture.

rules.rule: Short hairstyles visually expose more facial structure.
rules.guidance: Use shorter styles when a clean and defined appearance is desired.

rules.rule: Medium-length hairstyles provide more styling flexibility.
rules.guidance: They can be used for textured, side-parted, swept-back and layered looks.

rules.rule: Longer hairstyles require consideration of hair density, texture and maintenance.
rules.guidance: Do not recommend long hair solely from face shape.

rules.rule: A textured crop can create a compact and contemporary appearance.
rules.guidance: It works especially well when controlled texture is preferred over large volume.

rules.rule: A classic side part creates a structured and versatile appearance.
rules.guidance: It can work for casual, smart-casual and formal outfits depending on styling.

rules.rule: A quiff adds visual height to the upper part of the hairstyle.
rules.guidance: Avoid excessive height when the face already appears noticeably long.

rules.rule: A pompadour creates substantial vertical volume.
rules.guidance: Use controlled height when facial proportions benefit from elongation, but avoid excessive height on already elongated faces.

rules.rule: A slick-back hairstyle creates a clean and mature visual direction.
rules.guidance: It can emphasize facial structure because the forehead and sides are visually exposed.

rules.rule: A middle part can create symmetrical visual framing.
rules.guidance: Consider hair texture and natural fall before recommending it.

rules.rule: A side-swept fringe can reduce the visual emphasis of a broad forehead.
rules.guidance: Use moderate fringe length rather than covering the entire face.

rules.rule: A fringe can visually shorten the forehead-to-chin distance.
rules.guidance: This can be useful when the face appears longer.

rules.rule: Very high side fades can increase the perception of vertical hairstyle volume.
rules.guidance: Balance the top and sides instead of automatically recommending the highest fade.

rules.rule: A low taper generally creates a subtle and versatile transition.
rules.guidance: It works well when the user wants a clean look without an aggressive fade.

rules.rule: Low taper keeps the sides relatively natural while cleaning the lower edges.
rules.guidance: Suitable for understated casual and smart-casual styling.

rules.rule: Mid fade creates a more visible transition around the sides.
rules.guidance: Use when a sharper contemporary appearance is desired.

rules.rule: High fade creates strong contrast between the sides and top.
rules.guidance: It should be balanced with the face shape and top-hair volume.

rules.rule: Taper and fade are not interchangeable descriptions.
rules.guidance: Taper generally maintains more hair on the sides while fade creates a stronger transition.

rules.rule: Undercut creates a stronger separation between the top and sides.
rules.guidance: Use when a high-contrast hairstyle is intentionally desired.

rules.rule: Layering can reduce excessive weight in thick hair.
rules.guidance: Use controlled layers instead of removing too much density.

rules.rule: Over-thinning thick hair can make the hairstyle appear uneven.
rules.guidance: Preserve enough density to maintain the intended silhouette.

rules.rule: Hairline visibility should be considered when suggesting very short front styles.
rules.guidance: Do not assume a hairstyle will hide or improve a hairline unless the image supports that conclusion.

rules.rule: Hairline and forehead proportions can influence the visual result of fringe hairstyles.
rules.guidance: Use moderate fringe when facial framing is desired.

rules.rule: A haircut should be selected according to maintenance preference when known.
rules.guidance: Low-maintenance users should receive simpler styles than users who regularly style their hair.

rules.rule: Beard recommendations should consider jaw structure, face shape and beard density.
rules.guidance: Do not recommend a beard style based only on face shape.

rules.rule: Short boxed beards create a defined but controlled facial frame.
rules.guidance: They can work across many casual and smart-casual looks.

rules.rule: Stubble creates a lighter facial texture than a full beard.
rules.guidance: It works well when the user wants definition without heavy facial hair.

rules.rule: Heavy beard volume can increase the visual weight of the lower face.
rules.guidance: Use controlled beard length when the lower face already appears visually heavy.

rules.rule: A fuller beard can add visual width and presence to a narrower lower face.
rules.guidance: Shape the sides and bottom according to the intended facial balance.

rules.rule: A pointed beard can visually emphasize a longer chin area.
rules.guidance: Use cautiously when the lower face already appears elongated.

rules.rule: A rounded beard shape can soften a sharp jaw appearance.
rules.guidance: Maintain clean edges while preserving the intended rounded silhouette.

rules.rule: A sharp cheek line creates a more defined beard appearance.
rules.guidance: It suits polished grooming styles but may look too formal for intentionally rugged styling.

rules.rule: A natural cheek line creates a softer and more relaxed beard appearance.
rules.guidance: Use for casual and relaxed grooming aesthetics.

rules.rule: Neckline placement strongly affects beard cleanliness.
rules.guidance: Keep the neckline controlled rather than allowing an undefined beard edge.

rules.rule: Mustache and beard should visually belong to the same grooming direction.
rules.guidance: Avoid pairing a very polished beard shape with an intentionally disconnected mustache style unless deliberate.

rules.rule: A connected mustache and beard can create a stronger facial frame.
rules.guidance: Use when facial hair density supports the connection naturally.

rules.rule: Patchy facial hair should not automatically be treated as a problem.
rules.guidance: Recommend shorter, cleaner shapes when density is uneven.

rules.rule: Low-density facial hair often looks cleaner at shorter lengths.
rules.guidance: Avoid recommending excessive beard length when the growth pattern is visibly uneven.

rules.rule: High-density facial hair provides more flexibility in beard length and shape.
rules.guidance: Use the desired visual style and face balance to determine the final shape.

rules.rule: A clean-shaven look exposes the full jawline and facial structure.
rules.guidance: It can complement formal, minimal and sharp grooming aesthetics.

rules.rule: A goatee visually concentrates facial hair around the chin and mouth.
rules.guidance: Use when that concentrated facial framing matches the desired style.

rules.rule: A mustache-only style places visual emphasis on the upper lip.
rules.guidance: It works best when intentionally coordinated with hairstyle and outfit character.

rules.rule: Beard length should remain proportionate to hairstyle volume.
rules.guidance: Very heavy hair and very heavy beard can create excessive facial visual weight.

rules.rule: Very short hair combined with a heavy beard creates strong lower-face emphasis.
rules.guidance: Use when that contrast is intentional.

rules.rule: Hairstyle and beard should create a coherent visual balance.
rules.guidance: When both hair and beard are visually heavy, control at least one area.

rules.rule: Textured hairstyle with short stubble creates a balanced contemporary casual look.
rules.guidance: Suitable for everyday and smart-casual outfits.

rules.rule: Classic side part with a short boxed beard creates a polished appearance.
rules.guidance: Suitable for smart-casual, office and semi-formal styling.

rules.rule: Slick-back hair with a clean beard shape creates a refined grooming direction.
rules.guidance: Coordinate with structured clothing and polished footwear.

rules.rule: Messy textured hair pairs naturally with light stubble.
rules.guidance: Avoid an overly precise beard shape if the hairstyle is intentionally relaxed.

rules.rule: Longer textured hair can work with a fuller but controlled beard.
rules.guidance: Keep overall grooming intentional rather than allowing both areas to become visually uncontrolled.

rules.rule: Very sharp fade with a very sharp beard creates a highly defined appearance.
rules.guidance: Use for clean contemporary looks when the user prefers high grooming definition.

rules.rule: Minimal haircut with minimal facial hair creates a clean understated aesthetic.
rules.guidance: Suitable for minimalist outfits and formal environments.

rules.rule: A strong beard can balance a relatively simple hairstyle.
rules.guidance: Keep the beard shape intentional and proportionate.

rules.rule: A high-volume hairstyle can be balanced with controlled facial hair.
rules.guidance: Avoid excessive visual competition between hair and beard.

rules.rule: Sunglasses should be selected using face width, face shape and frame proportion.
rules.guidance: The frame should look proportionate rather than simply following a face-shape chart.

rules.rule: Frame width should generally correspond reasonably with facial width.
rules.guidance: Avoid frames that appear dramatically narrower or wider than the face unless intentionally styled.

rules.rule: Round frames create softer visual geometry.
rules.guidance: They can contrast effectively with angular facial features.

rules.rule: Square frames create stronger angular structure.
rules.guidance: They can complement softer or rounder facial features.

rules.rule: Rectangular frames create a horizontal structured effect.
rules.guidance: They can work well when a sharper visual direction is desired.

rules.rule: Aviator frames add a classic and visually noticeable accessory element.
rules.guidance: Coordinate frame color and lens tone with the outfit.

rules.rule: Wayfarer-style frames provide a versatile casual-to-smart-casual direction.
rules.guidance: They can be used when a balanced everyday frame is desired.

rules.rule: Browline frames emphasize the upper portion of the face.
rules.guidance: Use when stronger upper-face framing is desired.

rules.rule: Oversized sunglasses create stronger visual emphasis around the eyes.
rules.guidance: Use them when the outfit supports a fashion-forward accessory statement.

rules.rule: Small narrow frames create a more compact accessory footprint.
rules.guidance: They should still be proportionate to the face and comfortable to wear.

rules.rule: Angular frames can complement rounder facial structures through geometric contrast.
rules.guidance: Prefer moderate frame width and avoid excessive sharpness when a softer look is desired.

rules.rule: Rounded frames can soften the appearance of angular facial structures.
rules.guidance: Use when the overall outfit benefits from softer visual lines.

rules.rule: Rectangular frames can add horizontal balance to longer facial proportions.
rules.guidance: Avoid extremely narrow frames when they make the face appear even longer.

rules.rule: Vertical frame height should be considered along with frame width.
rules.guidance: A very tall frame can visually occupy more facial space.

rules.rule: Frame color should coordinate with the overall accessory palette.
rules.guidance: Black, brown, tortoiseshell and metallic frames can be matched to the outfit's visual direction.

rules.rule: Gold or warm metallic frames can complement warm accessory palettes.
rules.guidance: Coordinate with watches, chains or other visible metal details when possible.

rules.rule: Silver or cool metallic frames can complement cool accessory palettes.
rules.guidance: Keep the metal family consistent when several accessories are visible.

rules.rule: Black frames provide strong contrast and are highly versatile.
rules.guidance: They work particularly well with monochrome and high-contrast outfits.

rules.rule: Brown or tortoiseshell frames create a warmer and softer accessory direction.
rules.guidance: They can coordinate naturally with beige, cream, brown and earth-tone outfits.

rules.rule: Sunglasses should not be recommended from face shape alone.
rules.guidance: Consider frame size, hairstyle, outfit, accessory color and desired aesthetic.

rules.rule: Formal outfits generally benefit from controlled and polished grooming.
rules.guidance: Use clean hairstyle structure, controlled facial hair and restrained accessories.

rules.rule: Casual outfits allow more texture and relaxed grooming.
rules.guidance: Textured hair, light stubble and natural beard lines can work when intentionally styled.

rules.rule: Smart-casual outfits benefit from grooming that sits between relaxed and formal.
rules.guidance: Use controlled hair texture and a clean but not overly formal beard shape.

rules.rule: Minimal outfits pair well with clean grooming and limited accessory complexity.
rules.guidance: Avoid introducing too many competing grooming statements.

rules.rule: Streetwear outfits can support stronger hairstyle texture and statement sunglasses.
rules.guidance: Keep the grooming intentional so the outfit remains visually coherent.

rules.rule: Traditional Indian outfits generally pair well with neat and controlled grooming.
rules.guidance: Short textured hair, side-parted hair, controlled beard or clean-shaven grooming can work depending on outfit formality.

rules.rule: Kurta outfits can support both clean-shaven and neatly shaped beard styles.
rules.guidance: The beard should complement the neckline and overall formality.

rules.rule: Blazers benefit from structured grooming.
rules.guidance: Use a controlled hairstyle and defined but proportionate facial hair.

rules.rule: Oversized outfits can be balanced with clean grooming.
rules.guidance: A defined hairstyle or controlled facial hair can prevent the overall look from becoming visually loose.

rules.rule: Very structured outfits can be softened with controlled natural hair texture.
rules.guidance: Avoid making every visual element equally rigid unless a highly formal aesthetic is intended.

rules.rule: Office grooming should prioritize neatness and controlled proportions.
rules.guidance: Choose hairstyles and facial hair that remain polished throughout the workday.

rules.rule: Interview grooming should be clean, simple and professional.
rules.guidance: Avoid experimental hairstyles or highly distracting accessories.

rules.rule: Date-night grooming can be polished while retaining some personal style.
rules.guidance: Use controlled texture and a defined but natural beard shape.

rules.rule: Wedding grooming should match the formality of the outfit.
rules.guidance: Structured hairstyles and neatly shaped facial hair work well with formal Indian and Western outfits.

rules.rule: Festival grooming can be polished while allowing slightly stronger styling details.
rules.guidance: Coordinate hairstyle and beard with the visual richness of the outfit.

rules.rule: Gym grooming should prioritize practicality.
rules.guidance: Recommend hairstyles that stay manageable during physical activity rather than purely decorative styles.

rules.rule: Travel grooming should prioritize low maintenance.
rules.guidance: Prefer hairstyles and beard shapes that remain presentable with minimal daily styling.

rules.rule: Party grooming can support stronger hairstyle texture or statement accessories.
rules.guidance: Keep the statement intentional and coordinated with the outfit.

rules.rule: Beach and resort outfits can support relaxed natural hair texture.
rules.guidance: Avoid overly formal grooming unless specifically requested.

rules.rule: Casual everyday grooming should balance appearance and maintenance effort.
rules.guidance: Recommend practical styles that can be recreated consistently.

rules.rule: Very short hair creates a clean and low-maintenance appearance.
rules.guidance: It also makes facial structure and hairline more visible.

rules.rule: Short hair provides a balance between maintenance and styling flexibility.
rules.guidance: It supports fades, tapers, crops, side parts and textured styles.

rules.rule: Medium hair provides greater flexibility for texture and direction.
rules.guidance: It can support side parts, middle parts, swept-back looks and layered styles.

rules.rule: Long hair requires more attention to shape and maintenance.
rules.guidance: Consider texture and density before recommending it.

rules.rule: Hair length should support the intended hairstyle silhouette.
rules.guidance: Do not recommend a hairstyle that requires substantially different length without clearly identifying the required change.

rules.rule: Natural texture should generally be preserved when it contributes positively to the hairstyle.
rules.guidance: Use styling methods that work with the hair rather than against it.

rules.rule: Fine straight hair can benefit from controlled texture and moderate volume.
rules.guidance: Avoid excessive product weight that can flatten the hairstyle.

rules.rule: Thick straight hair can benefit from layering and controlled side volume.
rules.guidance: Reduce excessive bulk without removing the hairstyle's intended density.

rules.rule: Wavy hair often benefits from medium-length textured styles.
rules.guidance: Let natural wave movement contribute to the hairstyle.

rules.rule: Curly hair often benefits from controlled shape rather than excessive flattening.
rules.guidance: Choose length according to curl pattern and desired silhouette.

rules.rule: Very dense curls can require additional shape management.
rules.guidance: Recommend styles that control silhouette while maintaining natural curl definition.

rules.rule: Coily hair should be evaluated according to natural pattern and density.
rules.guidance: Avoid applying straight-hair assumptions to coily texture.

rules.rule: Hair volume should be evaluated separately from hair length.
rules.guidance: Long hair is not always high volume and short hair is not always low volume.

rules.rule: Hair part direction should follow natural fall when possible.
rules.guidance: A forced part can make styling less practical.

rules.rule: Hair texture visible in an image should be treated as an observed characteristic, not a guaranteed permanent trait.
rules.guidance: Lighting, styling products and image quality can alter apparent texture.

rules.rule: Grooming should have one clear visual focal point.
rules.guidance: If hairstyle is highly noticeable, keep beard and sunglasses relatively controlled unless a maximalist style is intentional.

rules.rule: Highly noticeable sunglasses should be balanced with a simpler hairstyle or beard.
rules.guidance: Avoid unnecessary competition among accessories and grooming.

rules.rule: A statement hairstyle can remain the focal point when facial hair is controlled.
rules.guidance: Use a clean beard outline or shorter beard length.

rules.rule: A strong beard can remain the focal point when hairstyle volume is controlled.
rules.guidance: Avoid excessive height and width in the hairstyle.

rules.rule: Hair, beard and sunglasses should not all use maximum visual intensity simultaneously.
rules.guidance: Control at least one or two elements for a more balanced result.

rules.rule: Black sunglasses coordinate naturally with black, grey, white and high-contrast outfits.
rules.guidance: Use black frames when a versatile neutral accessory is needed.

rules.rule: Brown sunglasses coordinate naturally with warm earth-tone outfits.
rules.guidance: Consider beige, cream, brown, olive and tan clothing.

rules.rule: Metallic sunglasses should coordinate with visible metal accessories.
rules.guidance: Gold, silver or mixed metals should be selected intentionally.

rules.rule: Statement sunglasses can elevate simple outfits.
rules.guidance: Use them as the accessory focal point rather than adding multiple competing accessories.

rules.rule: Minimal outfits benefit from simple frame shapes.
rules.guidance: Avoid unnecessarily decorative sunglasses when the clothing is already highly minimal.

rules.rule: Streetwear can support bold frame proportions and contemporary shapes.
rules.guidance: Match the frame scale to the oversized or relaxed clothing silhouette.

rules.rule: Formal outfits generally benefit from restrained sunglasses designs.
rules.guidance: Use classic frame shapes and neutral colors when sunglasses are appropriate.

rules.rule: Resort outfits can support lighter-colored or warmer frame palettes.
rules.guidance: Coordinate with linen, cream, beige and relaxed summer styling.

rules.rule: Monochrome outfits can use contrasting sunglasses as an intentional accent.
rules.guidance: Keep the frame proportion controlled so the accent does not overpower the outfit.

rules.rule: Accessory repetition improves visual cohesion.
rules.guidance: Repeat a frame color or metal tone through another visible accessory when appropriate.

rules.rule: Clean structured hairstyles complement tailored clothing.
rules.guidance: Use side parts, controlled quiffs, slick-backs or neat short styles depending on face and hair characteristics.

rules.rule: Textured hairstyles complement relaxed and casual clothing.
rules.guidance: Preserve natural movement instead of forcing a formal finish.

rules.rule: Medium-length textured hair can complement oversized streetwear.
rules.guidance: Keep the hairstyle's volume proportionate to the oversized silhouette.

rules.rule: Very polished hair can create contrast with distressed or rugged outfits.
rules.guidance: Use this contrast intentionally rather than automatically treating it as mismatched.

rules.rule: Natural textured hair can soften highly structured outfits.
rules.guidance: Maintain controlled texture so the look remains intentional.

rules.rule: Minimal clothing pairs well with clean understated hairstyles.
rules.guidance: Avoid unnecessary styling complexity.

rules.rule: Traditional outfits can support classic side parts and neatly controlled textured hairstyles.
rules.guidance: Choose grooming intensity according to outfit richness and occasion.

rules.rule: Black outfits can support both sharp and textured hairstyles.
rules.guidance: Select the hairstyle according to the desired character of the outfit.

rules.rule: Light summer outfits often work well with natural textured grooming.
rules.guidance: Avoid unnecessarily heavy styling products or overly rigid silhouettes.

rules.rule: Winter layered outfits can support slightly fuller hairstyle volume.
rules.guidance: Keep hair volume proportionate to the overall clothing layers.

rules.rule: AI should communicate grooming recommendations as styling suggestions rather than guaranteed outcomes.
rules.guidance: Use language such as 'can work well' when the image does not provide enough evidence.

rules.rule: Do not infer exact hair texture when image quality is insufficient.
rules.guidance: Mark texture as uncertain and provide adaptable options.

rules.rule: Do not infer exact beard density from a low-resolution image.
rules.guidance: Recommend styles compatible with both moderate and high density when uncertain.

rules.rule: Do not make medical or diagnostic claims from facial or hair appearance.
rules.guidance: Keep recommendations focused on styling and grooming.

rules.rule: Do not assume a person's age from appearance for grooming recommendations.
rules.guidance: Use visible styling characteristics instead.

rules.rule: Do not infer personality from hairstyle, beard or facial appearance.
rules.guidance: Recommendations should be based on visible styling characteristics and stated preferences.

rules.rule: If the face is partially covered, sunglasses or hairstyle recommendations should have lower confidence.
rules.guidance: Use only visible facial proportions and provide alternatives.

rules.rule: If the image is front-facing, face-shape analysis can generally be more reliable than from a strong side angle.
rules.guidance: Reduce confidence when perspective distortion is significant.

rules.rule: Lighting should be considered before assessing hair and facial proportions.
rules.guidance: Strong shadows can distort visible facial boundaries.

rules.rule: Image filters should not be treated as natural hair or skin characteristics.
rules.guidance: Base recommendations on visible structural information rather than color filters.

rules.rule: Low-maintenance users should receive hairstyles requiring minimal daily styling.
rules.guidance: Prefer short textured cuts, tapers or naturally manageable styles.

rules.rule: High-maintenance styling should only be recommended when the user appears willing to style regularly.
rules.guidance: Mention styling effort when a recommendation requires significant daily work.

rules.rule: Short fades and tapers require regular maintenance to preserve their sharp appearance.
rules.guidance: Consider upkeep frequency when recommending very precise cuts.

rules.rule: Medium-length textured styles can provide a balance between flexibility and maintenance.
rules.guidance: They can often be styled in multiple directions.

rules.rule: Longer hairstyles generally require more attention to shape and condition.
rules.guidance: Recommend them when the user accepts additional maintenance.

rules.rule: A hairstyle recommendation should include a maintenance level when useful.
rules.guidance: Use simple labels such as low, medium or high maintenance.

rules.rule: A hairstyle should be realistically achievable from the user's visible current hair length.
rules.guidance: If additional growth is needed, state that the result requires length.

rules.rule: A hairstyle requiring substantially shorter sides should be described as a haircut change rather than simple styling.
rules.guidance: Distinguish between styling and cutting requirements.

rules.rule: Product recommendations should focus on styling purpose rather than unnecessary product quantity.
rules.guidance: Recommend lightweight, medium or strong hold only according to the desired hairstyle.

rules.rule: Hair styling should preserve a natural appearance when the outfit aesthetic is relaxed.
rules.guidance: Avoid recommending an overly rigid finish for casual looks.

rules.rule: Short beard styles generally require regular trimming to maintain clean proportions.
rules.guidance: Keep cheek and neckline boundaries controlled.

rules.rule: Longer beards require more shape management than short stubble.
rules.guidance: Consider beard density and desired silhouette before recommending length.

rules.rule: Uneven beard growth is often easier to manage with shorter lengths.
rules.guidance: Avoid forcing a long beard shape when density is visibly inconsistent.

rules.rule: A clean neckline improves the visual definition of most beard styles.
rules.guidance: Use a controlled neckline rather than an undefined transition.

rules.rule: Beard edges should match the intended grooming level.
rules.guidance: Sharp edges suit polished looks while softer edges suit relaxed styles.

rules.rule: A narrow chin can visually support moderate beard fullness around the lower face.
rules.guidance: Avoid excessive pointed length if the goal is visual balance.

rules.rule: A broad jaw can be complemented by controlled beard sides.
rules.guidance: Avoid adding unnecessary width when the lower face is already visually strong.

rules.rule: A longer face can be visually balanced with controlled beard length and moderate hairstyle height.
rules.guidance: Avoid adding excessive vertical length to both hair and beard.

rules.rule: A rounder face can benefit from controlled side hair volume and some upper-face height.
rules.guidance: Keep the beard sides controlled to avoid increasing lower-face width.

rules.rule: A square face can support structured beard lines and textured hairstyles.
rules.guidance: Use the natural jaw structure rather than trying to hide it.

rules.rule: For a black oversized t-shirt outfit, clean textured hair and short stubble can create a balanced casual look.
rules.guidance: Use controlled grooming to balance the relaxed clothing silhouette.

rules.rule: For a white shirt and dark trousers, a side part or controlled textured hairstyle can support a smart-casual look.
rules.guidance: Keep facial hair neat and proportionate.

rules.rule: For a blazer and trousers, structured hair with clean facial hair creates a cohesive polished direction.
rules.guidance: Keep sunglasses minimal if they are used.

rules.rule: For a denim jacket outfit, textured hair and light-to-medium facial hair can reinforce the casual character.
rules.guidance: Avoid overly formal grooming unless intentional contrast is desired.

rules.rule: For a leather jacket outfit, textured hair and defined stubble can complement the stronger outfit character.
rules.guidance: Keep the beard shape controlled rather than excessively elaborate.

rules.rule: For a linen outfit, natural textured hair and lighter facial hair can support a relaxed summer aesthetic.
rules.guidance: Avoid overly rigid styling.

rules.rule: For a kurta, neatly styled hair and a controlled beard create a polished traditional look.
rules.guidance: Increase grooming precision for more formal festive outfits.

rules.rule: For a polo and chinos outfit, a clean taper or side part with short stubble works well for a refined casual direction.
rules.guidance: Keep grooming clean but not excessively formal.

rules.rule: For a hoodie and jogger outfit, natural textured hair and light stubble maintain a relaxed visual direction.
rules.guidance: Avoid overly formal hair styling.

rules.rule: For a monochrome outfit, grooming can introduce texture without adding unnecessary color complexity.
rules.guidance: Use hairstyle shape or beard texture as the visual detail.

rules.rule: For a date outfit, grooming should look intentional but not excessively rigid.
rules.guidance: Controlled hairstyle texture and clean facial hair usually create a balanced appearance.

rules.rule: For an office outfit, grooming should remain consistent with a professional environment.
rules.guidance: Prefer clean lines, controlled texture and restrained accessories.

rules.rule: For a wedding outfit, grooming precision should match the formality of the clothing.
rules.guidance: Structured hairstyle and neatly shaped facial hair can complement formal tailoring.

rules.rule: For a festival outfit, grooming can be slightly more expressive while remaining coordinated.
rules.guidance: Stronger hairstyle texture or a polished beard shape can complement richer clothing.

rules.rule: For travel outfits, choose grooming styles that remain manageable with limited styling time.
rules.guidance: Favor practical hair length and controlled facial hair.

rules.rule: For gym outfits, shorter or naturally manageable hairstyles can improve practicality.
rules.guidance: The recommendation should prioritize comfort and maintenance.

rules.rule: For party outfits, a statement hairstyle or sunglasses can act as the grooming focal point.
rules.guidance: Avoid making every grooming element equally bold.

rules.rule: For resort outfits, relaxed hair texture and lighter grooming can support the environment.
rules.guidance: Keep the overall look intentional rather than overly formal.

rules.rule: For formal black outfits, clean structured grooming creates a cohesive appearance.
rules.guidance: Use restrained sunglasses and controlled facial hair if visible.

rules.rule: For earth-tone outfits, warm accessory tones and natural grooming textures can create visual harmony.
rules.guidance: Brown or tortoiseshell sunglasses can be considered when frame proportions suit the face.

rules.rule: A grooming recommendation should provide a primary hairstyle option and at least one practical alternative when confidence is moderate.
rules.guidance: This prevents the system from presenting one uncertain prediction as a fixed answer.

rules.rule: Hairstyle recommendations should include the required hair length when it differs from the visible current length.
rules.guidance: Clearly distinguish current-hair styling from haircut or growth requirements.

rules.rule: Sunglasses recommendations should include frame shape and approximate visual scale.
rules.guidance: For example, describe a medium-width rectangular frame rather than only saying 'rectangular sunglasses'.

rules.rule: Beard recommendations should include approximate length and shape.
rules.guidance: Use practical descriptions such as short boxed beard, light stubble or controlled full beard.

rules.rule: Grooming recommendations should explain the visual reason briefly.
rules.guidance: Use explanations such as 'adds structure', 'keeps the sides controlled' or 'balances the outfit volume'.

rules.rule: Recommendations should distinguish between hairstyle, haircut and grooming finish.
rules.guidance: A haircut changes structure; styling changes how existing hair is arranged; finish describes texture or hold.

rules.rule: When multiple styles are compatible, recommendations should present alternatives based on desired aesthetic.
rules.guidance: Examples include clean, textured, classic and fashion-forward directions.

rules.rule: When image evidence is weak, recommendations should remain adaptable.
rules.guidance: Use conditional language and avoid overly specific structural claims.

rules.rule: Grooming advice should remain focused on style rather than changing a person's identity or facial characteristics.
rules.guidance: Recommend styling choices, not claims about inherent attractiveness or personality.

rules.rule: If the user provides a specific desired aesthetic, that preference should take priority over generic grooming formulas.
rules.guidance: Use the knowledge base to refine the requested style rather than replacing it.

rules.rule: Clean grooming emphasizes precision, simplicity and controlled shapes.
rules.guidance: Suitable for formal, office and minimalist styling.

rules.rule: Textured grooming emphasizes natural movement and visual depth.
rules.guidance: Suitable for casual, streetwear and contemporary styling.

rules.rule: Classic grooming emphasizes timeless shapes and moderate styling.
rules.guidance: Side parts, controlled tapers and neat facial hair can support this direction.

rules.rule: Rugged grooming uses visible texture and less polished facial-hair edges.
rules.guidance: Keep the overall appearance intentional rather than uncontrolled.

rules.rule: Fashion-forward grooming can use stronger silhouettes or statement accessories.
rules.guidance: Use one or two clear statement elements rather than making every element extreme.

rules.rule: Minimal grooming reduces visual complexity.
rules.guidance: Use simple hair structure, restrained facial hair and limited accessories.

rules.rule: Luxury-inspired grooming generally benefits from precision and restraint.
rules.guidance: Clean hair structure, controlled beard lines and subtle premium accessories work well.

rules.rule: Sporty grooming should prioritize practicality and clean structure.
rules.guidance: Use manageable hair and controlled facial hair.

rules.rule: Preppy grooming often works with neat side parts, tapered cuts and controlled facial hair.
rules.guidance: Coordinate grooming with polos, shirts, chinos and structured casual clothing.

rules.rule: Streetwear grooming can support textured hair, modern fades and statement eyewear.
rules.guidance: Keep proportions consistent with oversized or relaxed clothing.

rules.rule: Before recommending grooming, identify which grooming elements are already visible in the image.
rules.guidance: Record hairstyle length, texture, beard presence, beard length, eyewear and visible face areas.

rules.rule: Do not recommend changing an already suitable grooming element without a clear styling reason.
rules.guidance: Improve or coordinate the existing look when possible.

rules.rule: When sunglasses are already present, evaluate their frame proportion before suggesting alternatives.
rules.guidance: Recommend alternatives only when they improve coordination or address a visible proportion mismatch.

rules.rule: When a beard is already styled, evaluate its shape before suggesting a different beard category.
rules.guidance: Small shape adjustments may be more appropriate than completely changing the beard.

rules.rule: When hair is already styled, distinguish between styling improvement and a completely different haircut.
rules.guidance: Give the least disruptive useful recommendation first.

rules.rule: If the face is partly hidden by hair, mask, phone or sunglasses, reduce face-shape confidence.
rules.guidance: Use only clearly visible facial boundaries.

rules.rule: If the image angle creates strong perspective distortion, avoid highly specific face-shape conclusions.
rules.guidance: Prefer general frame and hairstyle recommendations.

rules.rule: If lighting changes facial boundaries, avoid treating shadows as actual jaw or cheekbone structure.
rules.guidance: Use visible geometry from well-lit areas.

rules.rule: If hair color appears altered by lighting or filters, do not make strong color recommendations from the image alone.
rules.guidance: Treat apparent color as uncertain when necessary.

rules.rule: If the image resolution is too low to distinguish grooming details, return broad recommendations instead of fabricated precision.
rules.guidance: Accuracy is more important than forcing a specific style label.

rules.rule: The final grooming recommendation should prioritize the user's outfit, face visibility, hair characteristics and desired occasion together.
rules.guidance: Do not generate recommendations from a single input feature.

rules.rule: For everyday casual styling, prioritize practical grooming that can be recreated easily.
rules.guidance: Avoid overly complex routines unless the user requests them.

rules.rule: For premium fashion styling, grooming should appear intentional and proportionate to the outfit.
rules.guidance: Use controlled hair, facial hair and eyewear coordination.

rules.rule: For a minimal fashion look, reduce unnecessary grooming complexity.
rules.guidance: Use a simple hairstyle, controlled facial hair and restrained eyewear.

rules.rule: For a bold fashion look, allow one clear grooming statement.
rules.guidance: The statement can be hairstyle, beard shape or sunglasses.

rules.rule: For formal styling, prioritize neatness before experimentation.
rules.guidance: Classic shapes are generally easier to coordinate with formal clothing.

rules.rule: For casual styling, natural texture can be used as a visual feature.
rules.guidance: Do not over-polish an intentionally relaxed outfit.

rules.rule: For streetwear styling, grooming volume should be considered alongside clothing volume.
rules.guidance: Balance oversized garments with controlled or intentionally textured grooming.

rules.rule: For traditional styling, grooming should respect the visual formality and richness of the outfit.
rules.guidance: Neat hair and controlled facial hair can support formal festive clothing.

rules.rule: When several grooming options are viable, rank them by compatibility with the visible outfit and requested style direction rather than by attractiveness.
rules.guidance: Avoid subjective attractiveness judgments.
